messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 5950001234 - High GPU OOM rate on inference-prod-usw2. Multiple containers restarted. Paging on-call.

maria_ong: taking pager, joining bridge.

devin: seeing repeated CUDA OOM in pod inference-abc-3 during prefill for very long prompts (~120k tokens). Logs: 
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 8.00 GiB (GPU 0; 15.90 GiB total capacity)
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```

kai: rolling traffic away from that pool to fallback hotpool (cpu-backed) and enabling PREFILL_TRIM=8192 on router config.

maria_ong: good. how many customers impacted?

luis-cs: CS: 3 paid customers reported increased 502s since 00:12 UTC, one is on Dedicated; they see repeated restarts and timeouts.

ashley: metrics: token failure rate +14%, container restarts spike, node flaps x2 in last 5m. Node kernel logs show NVML reset events.

devin: quick mitigation: apply aggressive kvcache eviction and reduce prefetch/prefill batch size. Command applied: 
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/runtime PREFILL_TRIM=8192 KV_EVICTION=true PREFETCH_BATCH=2
```

ops-bot: rollout started for pool 'gpu-prefill-1' -> updated pods: 3/3 :white_check_mark:.

maria_ong: monitor for 10m then decide whether to keep fallback routing. assigning handoff to @kai (night_oncall) at 5950001240.

kai: opening incident page and adding customer notes now. incident id ir-2026-045.

luis-cs: sending customer update: "We're mitigating high memory prefill issues by routing traffic to fallback and applying trimming; engineering is investigating root cause. ETA ~20m."

ashley: observed one node had a kernel OOPS before restart; nvml reset code 0x3 in dmesg. saving artifacts.

devin: suggestion: add per-request max_prompt_length enforcement for large-context models and cap CUDA mem for that variant as a short-term safety valve.

maria_ong: oncall handoff note -> @kai will take the bridge at 5950001240. I've added notes and mitigation steps to ir-2026-045. :thumbsup: 

kai: taking it. immediate next steps: keep fallback for traffic spikes >95th percentile; schedule hotpatch tomorrow to add smarter prefill trimming and prefetch throttling.

luis-cs: customer messages sent, will update if any reply/pressure.

ops-bot: incident page updated: https://redwood.incidents/ir-2026-045 (artifacts attached).

maria_ong: marking pager resolved for me. If issue resurfaces escalate to SRE lead.

kai: will keep monitoring. creating follow-up: postmortem task, reproduce prompt set, and add an eval to catch long-prefill OOMs.

ashley: heap traces, kvcache stats, and node kernel logs uploaded to ir-2026-045 -> artifacts.

devin: quick note for postmortem: suspected regression in prefetch/window expansion from change on 2026-03-09; include config diff in analysis.

maria_ong: closing thread here; handoff complete. Great job team. :wave:
